name: TabBar
description: App destination navigation extracted from CartPage, with native links or action buttons, controlled current destination, decorative icons and quantity badges.

figma.notes: Extracted from the maintained CartPage implementation; no independently verified Figma component binding.

items.description: Unique value, label, decorative icon, optional badgeCount and either href or onClick. Empty arrays render nothing.

value.description: Host-controlled current destination. Does not update automatically.

aria-label.description: Accessible name for the app navigation.

focus.note: 2px blue inset focus outline stays visible when fixed against viewport edges.

tapTarget.note: 48px targets; use 3–5 destinations in a phone viewport.

accessibility.ariaPattern: Named nav with explicit aria-current=page; not an ARIA tablist.
accessibility.notes: Icons are decorative; count badges are included in each item accessible name using the full quantity. Native link and button keyboard behavior.

testing.rationale: Story play checks controlled action activation and keyboard focus; browser coverage checks links, counts, geometry and responsive CartPage integration.
